description: Files one CLOSED request away for the buyer. It takes the `id` of the request. For a request to several dealerships, it also takes the `rowKey` of the one dealership. No dealership is told, and nobody is notified. An open request is not archived. It does nothing else to the request. It answers `{ archived: true }`.

rowKey.description: For a request to several dealerships: the key of the one dealership.

name: archive_request
title: Archive a request
